request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply: The available evidence offers cost data, but does not establish a first-of-class ship’s actual overrun against its original baseline. The latest source reports a CBO projection that FFG-62 frigates would average 10%–20% above updated Navy estimates—not an actual lead-ship overrun (CRS R44972, 2026-01-20, PDF p. 39). For the Ford-class lead ship, CRS reports CVN-78’s final procurement cost as $13,316.5 million in then-year dollars (CRS RS20643, 2025-12-04, PDF p. 7); it separately reports a revised statutory cap of $13,224.0 million, which is not the original baseline (PDF p. 12). See the brief for details and source links.
reply.reasoning: Verified findings provide recent projected cost-growth context for FFG-62 and final cost/cap data for CVN-78, but not a comparable actual-versus-original-baseline overrun.
